item.title: The Secrets of Antarctica and FLAT EARTH!!! (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Brock Pivec is an author and researcher whose fascination with hidden history, mysterious documents, and unexplained events inspired his EX ARCADIA book series. The story begins with a survey box sealed in Antarctica in 1947 and a mysterious chart of the world that a secretive order has spent generations trying to bury. His first two books, The Center of the Great Unknown and The Answering Shore, take readers on a journey through historical mysteries, forgotten knowledge, and the possibility that our understanding of the world may be incomplete.

Beyond his fiction, Brock explores the historical records and unusual theories that inspired his writing. His companion work, The Conspiracy Theorist's Guide, brings together source materials behind the EX ARCADIA series. From Admiral Richard Byrd's Antarctic expeditions and the mysterious May 3, 1964, "Moon a Mirage" headline to the appearance of Tartaria on historical maps, Brock examines where documented history ends and speculation begins. His work invites readers to question familiar narratives while distinguishing historical evidence from imaginative storytelling.
